title: PRD-02 Deansgate step-through line
summary: Operational cost centre for the Deansgate step-through assembly line in unit NBC-MAN-01 under owner DOKAFOR.
body:
Cost centre PRD-02 covers the Deansgate step-through production line within manufacturing unit NBC-MAN-01 [^r1]. The cost centre is currently OPEN under owner DOKAFOR [^r1]. For 2026-Q4 as of 26 October 2026 09:00, PRD-02 has an allocated budget of £623,000, with committed spend of £244,996.16 and an available balance of £378,003.84 [^r2].

## Budget and spending

Budget allocations and commitments are recorded in [[data-cost-centres-and-budgets|Cost Centres and Budgets FY2026-27]] [^r1][^r2].

| Period | Total budget | Committed spend | Available budget | As of |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-Q4 | £623,000.00 | £244,996.16 | £378,003.84 | 2026-10-26 09:00 [^r2] |
